summary: A value between a min and a max, one thumb or two for a range, in three shapes and three thumb shadows.

props.name: label
props.description: Text beside the value, above the track.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends a red asterisk to the label.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the control, for context on what the value means.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: A single number for one thumb, or a two-item array for a range with two. Whichever shape you start with is the shape the slider keeps - it does not switch thumb count at runtime.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value, same shape rule as `defaultValue`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value on every change. Required for a controlled slider.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount each keyboard press or drag increment changes the value by.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius, applied to the track, the indicator and the thumb together. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth on the thumb only. The track and indicator are flush with the control, so a shadow on them would read as a stray line rather than depth.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: How the value is shown beside the label. Defaults to `50%` for one thumb, `20 - 80` for a range; override for currency, units, or anything else.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the outer wrapper's classes, so any Yumma CSS utility you pass wins.
